question_1.question: Does Polars solve 80%+ of your performance issues?

if_yes.rationale: Lower risk, faster implementation, significant gains
if_yes.next_step: Evaluate remaining bottlenecks after Polars migration

question_2.question: Do you have 1-3 clear CPU bottlenecks taking >40% of runtime?

question_3.question: Is your entire data pipeline consistently slow?

if_yes.rationale: Complete pipeline replacement for maximum gains
if_yes.implementation: Separate Rust service with HTTP/gRPC API

team_skills: At least one team member comfortable with systems programming
Experience with C/C++ or similar low-level languages
Willingness to learn Rust language basics
technical_requirements: CI/CD pipeline that can handle Rust builds
business_factors: Timeline allows for 4+ weeks of development
Team has capacity for learning new technology

when_not_to_use_rust: Performance issues are due to I/O waiting, not CPU
Bottlenecks are in database queries or network calls

development_metrics: Bug rate in Rust vs Python code
